description: Deterministic public strategy planner. Builds ordered steps, warnings, live checks, and step output references for one supported route.

allow_zero_mins.description: Optional explicit acknowledgement for zero-minimum Uniswap LP minting. Only use this when you intentionally accept that risk.

amount_link.description: Optional LINK amount to thread into the plan.

amount_link_min.description: Optional LINK minimum for the Uniswap LP builder step.

amount_sdl.description: Optional SDL amount to thread into the Uniswap V3 strategy plan.

amount_sdl_min.description: Optional SDL minimum for the Uniswap LP builder step.

slippage_bps.description: Optional slippage guard for swap and LP steps. Default: 50.

wallet.description: Optional wallet address for pre-filled builder calls.

name: sdl_strategy_plan
